items.q: Which channel provides the fastest response?
items.a: LINE Official Account (@830sdfow) provides the fastest response, averaging under 15 minutes during business hours (09:00 - 24:00 daily).

items.q: Can I schedule a Live Demo?
items.a: Yes! For stores or enterprise brands wanting a walkthrough of POS, multi-branch stock, or custom workflows, contact us to schedule a free video demo.
Our cloud infrastructure is monitored 24/7 with automated uptime checks, and Enterprise clients receive dedicated 24-hour hotline access.

items.q: Do you assist with POS printer and hardware setup?
items.a: Yes, our technical team assists with driver setup for thermal printers, cash drawers, and barcode scanners via LINE or remote support tools.
